landing.metaTitle: Spotifood — QR code table ordering for restaurants
landing.metaDescription: Digitize your menu and ordering: guests scan, order and pay from their table. Real-time kitchen, split payments, invoices and reviews.
landing.title: Guests scan. Order. Pay.
landing.subtitle: Spotifood turns every table into an ordering point. Online menu, real-time kitchen orders, individual payments and invoices — no app to install.

qr.title: One QR per table
qr.body: Generate and print QR codes for all your tables in one click.

split.title: Everyone pays their share
split.body: Several guests at one table, each with their own cart and bill.

live.title: Live kitchen
live.body: Orders reach the kitchen and floor instantly.

insights.title: Sales & reviews
insights.body: Revenue, best sellers, reviews and complaints in one place.
